narrative.overview: FUNG is a tactile desktop instrument for work that must remain understandable after the moment has passed. The working surface is a porcelain command deck, not a dashboard collage. Call.md may inform information hierarchy but FUNG implements its own Tauri/React, local-first and evidence-bound UI.

rules.name: Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: A semantic color appears only when it explains current state, action priority or provenance.

rules.name: Evidence-First Type Rule
rules.body: Timestamp, speaker label and inference boundary remain distinct from generated prose.

rules.name: Ownership Before Polish Rule
rules.body: Correct a surface's zone ownership before changing shadow, blur, opacity or colour.

dos: Do preserve the porcelain command-deck identity.
Do show source, timestamp, provider and uncertainty with generated output.
Do use Call.md only as a task-order and information-hierarchy reference.
donts: Don't copy Call.md branding, assets, code or VideoDB-specific UI.
Don't add nested cards, gradient text or decorative glass layers.
Don't label inference or speaker identity as fact without evidence.
